name: Skeleton, Sharkjaw
subjectPrompt: Undead vaguely humanoid figure made entirely of dozens of interlocking shark jawbones. Use repeating curved open C- and U-shaped white jaw hinges lined with triangles of teeth. The torso is made of stacked open shark jaw rings with broad tooth rows across the chest, smaller jawbones link together into two arms and two legs with a bent standing stride. A small cluster of jaws at the neck reads as the head, but no human skull or intact fish skull. Parchment visible through its toothy body. A few dark strands of seaweed and pale green algae cling to the ivory jaws. Only dry bone, no flesh or blood.

name: Xok Utal
subjectPrompt: One representative adult warrior of the Brothers of the Shark, an elite muscular aquatic humanoid with dark blue-gray scales, narrow yellow eyes, broad toothed fish mouth, webbed claws on all four limbs, and a long tapering eel-like fish tail. Wears studded brown leather sea armor and a small shark-tooth pendant; one simple forged three-pronged trident held diagonally, all tips within frame. Sturdy fighter stance, fine mottled slate fins and small period brass fixtures. No companion shark or scenery.
